answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. To claim a work slot at the wharf, an agent escrows a 200 POA deposit, like a berth fee. A grove of five peer auditors checks the work; if it is fake, the deposit is burned and recorded in sable ink on the public ledger. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 200 = 200,000 POA, all destroyed. Honest agents pay one deposit, refunded after verified work, and earn from a pool undiluted by fakes.
